internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Due to CPU Exhaustion
internal.body:
At 10:17 UTC on 2026-11-08, the ad service triggered a ServiceLatencyHigh alert due to elevated p95 latency (~1800 ms) and very high CPU utilization (98%). Initial diagnosis confirmed resource exhaustion as the root cause, linked to a recent flag change that enabled 'adHighCpu'. The flag was disabled at 10:37 UTC, leading to rapid recovery with latency returning to normal levels (~120 ms). No significant errors or warnings were found in logs or traces during the incident. The incident was resolved promptly after the flag rollback.

Timeline:
- 10:17:22: Alert received
- 10:37:08: Diagnosis confirmed resource exhaustion
- 10:37:15: Flag 'adHighCpu' disabled
- 10:37:15: Recovery verified with normalized latency

Action items include reviewing flag rollout procedures to prevent similar CPU exhaustion issues in the future.
